clips.title: The story
paras: In Ratchet, Mebok Mizzyrix wants intact raptor horns for a scheme of his own. The goblin believes the cunning of Barrens raptors lies in their horns and hires travelers to hunt Sunscale Scytheclaws.

Mebok Mizzyrix looks for fortune in Ratchet, where goblins chase one scheme after another. He has watched the Barrens raptors act with unusual craft and coordination compared with beasts elsewhere. Mebok decided their intelligence must be held in their horns. He has no formal inquiry in mind; he wants to put this idea to profit.

Mebok wants undamaged horns from Sunscale Scytheclaws, among the Barrens' deadliest predators. They prowl the southern stretches of the Barrens and the northern borders near Ashenvale. The raptors hunt in packs and defend their territory fiercely, so bringing down one and taking its horns intact calls for considerable skill in battle.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The raptors of the Barrens are smarter than raptors in other lands. And I think all that smarts is hiding in their horns! If so, then I could grind their horns into powder and use it to make "smart drinks." I could sell them for a fortune!!!
And you can help me. Find me intact raptor horns from sunscale scytheclaws. They roam in the southern Barrens, and in the northern Barrens near the border of Ashenvale Forest.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you get the horns, friend? Those things are going to make me a fortune!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Great, you got them! Now I just need to ground them down and mix them with some wine, and...
